usage.finalMessage:
Double-booking support is built but turned off: no booking is shown to be for the diabetes review clinic, so DEC-C02 still refuses every second booking (commit `3d376df`).
`dotnet test` has 6 passing and 2 failing: both provided CLIN-24 acceptance tests, which expect a Monday double-booking for Dr. Patel. That conflict, and whether every Monday appointment of Dr. Patel's is the diabetes review clinic, are recorded for Clinical Operations and Dr. Mori.
Details are in `.work/report.json` and `.decisions/decisions.json` (new DEC-W-9 and DEC-W-10 are still `proposed`).
